chunks: 1306 - And in the narration of Al-‘Alā’, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Ja‘far عليه السلام, he said:

“If the traveler prays behind resident people, then he should complete his prayer as two rak‘ahs and give salām. And if he prays al-Ẓuhr with them, then he should make the first two al-Ẓuhr and the last two al-‘Aṣr.”

key_terms.الْمُسَافِرُ: the traveler, whose prayer rulings differ during travel
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيْنِ: two rak‘ahs, the shortened unit count for the traveler

ai.seo_question: How does a traveler pray behind residents according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning the traveler praying behind residents. It explains how the traveler counts his rak‘ahs and, in the case of praying al-Ẓuhr with them, how the first two are for al-Ẓuhr and the final two are counted as al-‘Aṣr.
